paragraphs.en: #1 on every major AI memory benchmark — LongMemEval , LoCoMo , and ConvoMem . 95% Recall@15 with a 99.4% context reduction · ~50ms user profiles. Read the research →
paragraphs.zh: 在所有主要 AI 记忆基准测试中排名第一 — LongMemEval、LoCoMo 和 ConvoMem。95% Recall@15，上下文缩减 99.4% · 约 50ms 的用户画像。阅读研究 →

paragraphs.en: Supermemory is the memory and context layer for AI. #1 on LongMemEval , LoCoMo , and ConvoMem — the three major benchmarks for AI memory.
paragraphs.zh: Supermemory 是 AI 的记忆与上下文层。在 LongMemEval、LoCoMo 和 ConvoMem 三大 AI 记忆基准测试中排名第一。

paragraphs.en: We are a research lab building the engine, plugins and tools around it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们是一个研究实验室，致力于构建引擎以及围绕它的插件和工具。

paragraphs.en: Your AI forgets everything between conversations. Supermemory fixes that.
paragraphs.zh: 你的 AI 在对话之间会遗忘一切。Supermemory 解决了这个问题。

paragraphs.en: It automatically learns from conversations, extracts facts, builds user profiles, handles knowledge updates and contradictions, forgets expired information, and delivers the right context at the right time. Full RAG, connectors, file processing — the entire context stack, one system.
paragraphs.zh: 它会自动从对话中学习、提取事实、构建用户画像、处理知识更新与矛盾、遗忘过期信息，并在合适的时机提供合适的上下文。 完整的 RAG、连接器、文件处理——整个上下文技术栈，一个系统搞定。

sents.en: It automatically learns from conversations, extracts facts, builds user profiles, handles knowledge updates and contradictions, forgets expired information, and delivers the right context at the right time.
sents.zh: 它会自动从对话中学习、提取事实、构建用户画像、处理知识更新与矛盾、遗忘过期信息，并在合适的时机提供合适的上下文。

sents.en: Full RAG, connectors, file processing — the entire context stack, one system.
sents.zh: 完整的 RAG、连接器、文件处理——整个上下文技术栈，一个系统搞定。

paragraphs.en: All of this is in our single memory structure and ontology.
paragraphs.zh: 所有这些都存在于我们单一的记忆结构和本体中。

paragraphs.en: Give Claude Code, Muse Code, Cursor, Codex and OpenCode persistent memory across every conversation with a plugin or the MCP server.
paragraphs.zh: 为 Claude Code、Muse Code、Cursor、Codex 和 OpenCode 提供跨每次对话的持久记忆，可通过插件或 MCP 服务器实现。

paragraphs.en: Your AI remembers your preferences, projects, past discussions — and gets smarter over time.
paragraphs.zh: 你的 AI 能记住你的偏好、项目和过往讨论——并随时间推移变得越来越聪明。

paragraphs.en: Add memory, RAG, user profiles, and connectors to your agents and apps with a single API .
paragraphs.zh: 通过单一 API 为你的智能体和应用添加记忆、RAG、用户画像和连接器。

paragraphs.en: No vector DB config. No embedding pipelines. No chunking strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 无需向量数据库配置。无需嵌入管道。无需分块策略。

paragraphs.en: State-of-the-art memory, on your machine. One binary. Zero config. Bring any model — or run fully offline with Ollama.
paragraphs.zh: 尖端的记忆功能，就在你的机器上。单个二进制文件，零配置。 接入任意模型——或通过 Ollama 完全离线运行。

paragraphs.zh: 内存按项目（容器标签）划分作用域，因此你可以将工作与个人上下文分开，或按客户、仓库或其他任何方式进行组织。

paragraphs.en: Claude Desktop · Cursor · Windsurf · VS Code · Claude Code · OpenCode · OpenClaw · Hermes
paragraphs.zh: Claude Desktop · Cursor · Windsurf · VS Code · Claude Code · OpenCode · OpenClaw · Hermes

paragraphs.zh: MCP 服务器是开源的——查看源代码。

paragraphs.en: { "mcpServers" : { "supermemory" : { "url" : " https://mcp.supermemory.ai/mcp " } } } Build with Supermemory (API) If you're building AI agents or apps, Supermemory gives you the entire context stack through one API — memory, RAG, user profiles, connectors, and file processing.
paragraphs.zh: { "mcpServers" : { "supermemory" : { "url" : " https://mcp.supermemory.ai/mcp " } } } 使用 Supermemory（API）构建 如果您正在构建 AI 智能体或应用程序，Supermemory 可以通过一个 API 为您提供完整的上下文技术栈——包括记忆、RAG、用户画像、连接器和文件处理。

paragraphs.en: npm install supermemory # or: pip install supermemory Quickstart import Supermemory from "supermemory" ; const client = new Supermemory ( ) ; // Store a conversation await client . add ( { content : "User loves TypeScript and prefers functional patterns" , containerTag : "user_123" , } ) ; // Get user profile + relevant memories in one call const { profile , searchResults } = await client . profile ( { containerTag : "user_123" , q : "What programming style does the user prefer?" , } ) ; // profile.static → ["Loves TypeScript", "Prefers functional patterns"] // profile.dynamic → ["Working on API integration"] // searchResults → Relevant memories ranked by similarity from supermemory import Supermemory client = Supermemory () client . add ( content = "User loves TypeScript and prefers functional patterns" , container_tag = "user_123" ) result = client . profile ( container_tag = "user_123" , q = "programming style" ) print ( result . profile . static ) # Long-term facts print ( result . profile . dynamic ) # Recent context Supermemory automatically extracts memories, builds user profiles, and returns relevant context. No embedding pipelines, no vector DB config, no chunking strategies.
paragraphs.zh: npm install supermemory # 或者：pip install supermemory 快速开始 import Supermemory from "supermemory" ; const client = new Supermemory ( ) ; // 存储一段对话 await client . add ( { content : "用户热爱 TypeScript 并且偏好函数式模式" , containerTag : "user_123" , } ) ; // 一次调用同时获取用户画像和相关记忆 const { profile , searchResults } = await client . profile ( { containerTag : "user_123" , q : "用户偏好什么样的编程风格？" , } ) ; // profile.static → ["热爱 TypeScript", "偏好函数式模式"] // profile.dynamic → ["正在开发 API 集成"] // searchResults → 按相似度排序的相关记忆 from supermemory import Supermemory client = Supermemory () client . add ( content = "用户热爱 TypeScript 并且偏好函数式模式" , container_tag = "user_123" ) result = client . profile ( container_tag = "user_123" , q = "编程风格" ) print ( result . profile . static ) # 长期事实 print ( result . profile . dynamic ) # 近期上下文 Supermemory 会自动提取记忆、构建用户画像，并返回相关的上下文。 无需嵌入流水线，无需向量数据库配置，无需分块策略。

paragraphs.en: Drop-in wrappers for every major AI framework:
paragraphs.zh: 适用于所有主流 AI 框架的即插即用封装：

paragraphs.en: // Vercel AI SDK import { withSupermemory } from "@supermemory/tools/ai-sdk" ; const model = withSupermemory ( openai ( "gpt-4o" ) , { containerTag : "user_123" , customId : "conv-1" } ) ; // Mastra import { withSupermemory } from "@supermemory/tools/mastra" ; const agent = new Agent ( withSupermemory ( config , "user-123" , { mode : "full" } ) ) ; Vercel AI SDK · LangChain · LangGraph · OpenAI Agents SDK · Mastra · Agno · Claude Memory Tool · n8n
paragraphs.zh: // Vercel AI SDK import { withSupermemory } from "@supermemory/tools/ai-sdk" ; const model = withSupermemory ( openai ( "gpt-4o" ) , { containerTag : "user_123" , customId : "conv-1" } ) ; // Mastra import { withSupermemory } from "@supermemory/tools/mastra" ; const agent = new Agent ( withSupermemory ( config , "user-123" , { mode : "full" } ) ) ; Vercel AI SDK · LangChain · LangGraph · OpenAI 智能体 SDK · Mastra · Agno · Claude Memory Tool · n8n

paragraphs.en: // Hybrid (default) — RAG + Memory in one query const results = await client . search ( { q : "how do I deploy?" , containerTag : "user_123" , searchMode : "hybrid" , } ) ; // Returns deployment docs (RAG) + user's deploy preferences (Memory) // Memories only const results = await client . search ( { q : "user preferences" , containerTag : "user_123" , searchMode : "memories" , } ) ; User profiles Traditional memory relies on search — you need to know what to ask for. Supermemory automatically maintains a profile for every user:
paragraphs.zh: // 混合（默认）— 在一次查询中同时使用 RAG + 记忆 const results = await client . search ( { q : "how do I deploy?" , containerTag : "user_123" , searchMode : "hybrid" , } ) ; // 返回部署文档（RAG）+ 用户的部署偏好（记忆） // 仅记忆 const results = await client . search ( { q : "user preferences" , containerTag : "user_123" , searchMode : "memories" , } ) ; 用户画像 传统记忆依赖搜索——你必须知道要查询什么。 Supermemory 会自动为每个用户维护一个画像：

sents.zh: Supermemory 会自动为每个用户维护一个画像：

paragraphs.en: const { profile } = await client . profile ( { containerTag : "user_123" } ) ; // profile.static → ["Senior engineer at Acme", "Prefers dark mode", "Uses Vim"] // profile.dynamic → ["Working on auth migration", "Debugging rate limits"] One call. ~50ms. sents.en: The full Memory API — documents, memories, user profiles, hybrid search — runs against http://localhost:6767 .
sents.zh: 完整的 Memory API——包括文档、记忆、用户画像、混合搜索——都运行在 http://localhost:6767 上。

paragraphs.en: const client = new Supermemory ( { apiKey : "sm_..." , baseURL : "http://localhost:6767" , // that's the only change } ) ; Bring any model — OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. An interactive wizard walks you through it on first boot. Embeddings — local Xenova/bge-base-en-v1.5 by default (no API key); optionally OpenAI, Gemini, or Ollama. Same provider stack as cloud. Offline text memories if you want — point it at Ollama ( gpt-oss:20b works great), disable telemetry with SUPERMEMORY_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 , and use local text or file inputs after the first embedding-model download. URL ingestion uses a hosted reader service. Your data, one directory — everything lives in ~/.supermemory , easy to back up or move. Same API as the platform — prototype locally, ship on the hosted platform by changing baseURL . Run with Docker Prebuilt images support Linux amd64 and arm64. You don’t need to build or clone the server source.
paragraphs.zh: const client = new Supermemory ( { apiKey : "sm_..." , baseURL : "http://localhost:6767" , // 这是唯一的改动 } ) ; 可使用任意模型——OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Groq，或任何与 OpenAI 兼容的端点。 首次启动时会有一个交互式向导引导你完成配置。 嵌入——默认使用本地的 Xenova/bge-base-en-v1.5（无需 API 密钥）；可选 OpenAI、Gemini 或 Ollama。 与云端相同的提供商技术栈。 如有需要可离线使用文本记忆——将其指向 Ollama（gpt-oss:20b 效果很好），通过 SUPERMEMORY_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 禁用遥测，并在首次下载嵌入模型后使用本地文本或文件输入。 URL 摄取使用托管的读取服务。 你的数据集中在一个目录——所有内容都存放在 ~/.supermemory 中，易于备份或迁移。 与平台相同的 API——在本地进行原型开发，只需修改 baseURL 即可部署到托管平台。 使用 Docker 运行 预构建镜像支持 Linux amd64 和 arm64。 你无需构建或克隆服务器源代码。

paragraphs.en: For a new installation, run these commands in an empty directory and set your own LLM provider key:
paragraphs.zh: 全新安装时，请在一个空目录中运行以下命令，并设置你自己的 LLM 提供商密钥：

paragraphs.en: release_url=https://github.com/supermemoryai/supermemory/releases curl -fL " $release_url /download/server-v0.0.9/compose.yaml " -o compose.yaml export OPENAI_API_KEY=your_openai_api_key_here export SUPERMEMORY_VERSION=0.0.9 docker compose up -d --wait --wait-timeout 180 The API listens on http://localhost:6767 . Data and credentials persist in the supermemory_supermemory-data volume. Get your local API key with docker compose exec supermemory cat /data/api-key ; requests require it even on localhost.

paragraphs.en: Supermemory is state of the art across all major AI memory benchmarks:
paragraphs.zh: Supermemory 在所有主要的 AI 记忆基准测试中均达到业界最先进水平：

paragraphs.en: On LongMemEval, supermemory reaches 95% Recall@15 while adding only ~720 tokens of context — a 99.4% context reduction (99.6% at @10, 99.8% at @5). Recall by category: Knowledge Updates 99%, Assistant recall 100%, User recall 97%, Multi-session 93%, Temporal Reasoning 91%, Preference 90%.
paragraphs.zh: 在 LongMemEval 上，supermemory 达到 95% 的 Recall@15，同时仅增加约 720 个 token 的上下文——上下文缩减达 99.4%（@10 时为 99.6%，@5 时为 99.8%）。 按类别统计的召回率：知识更新 99%，助手回忆 100%，用户回忆 97%，多会话 93%，时间推理 91%，偏好 90%。

sents.en: On LongMemEval, supermemory reaches 95% Recall@15 while adding only ~720 tokens of context — a 99.4% context reduction (99.6% at @10, 99.8% at @5).

paragraphs.en: We also built the Supermemory Filesystem (SMFS) , which uses 3.0× fewer tokens on Claude (24M vs 72M) and 1.75× fewer on Codex across the 110-question xAFS benchmark. See the full write-ups on our research page .
paragraphs.zh: 我们还构建了 Supermemory 文件系统（SMFS），在 110 道题的 xAFS 基准测试中，它在 Claude 上的 token 消耗减少了 3.0 倍（24M 对 72M），在 Codex 上减少了 1.75 倍。 请在我们的研究页面查看完整的详细报告。

paragraphs.en: Your app / AI tool ↓ Supermemory │ ├── Memory Engine Extracts facts, tracks updates, resolves contradictions, │ auto-forgets expired info ├── User Profiles Static facts + dynamic context built from engine, always fresh ├── Hybrid Search RAG + Memory in one query ├── Connectors Real-time sync from Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, GitHub... └── File Processing PDFs, images, videos, code → searchable chunks Memory is not RAG. RAG retrieves document chunks — stateless, same results for everyone. Memory extracts and tracks facts about users over time. It understands that "I just moved to SF" supersedes "I live in NYC." Supermemory runs both together by default, so you get knowledge base retrieval and personalized context in every query. Read more about this here - https://supermemory.ai/docs/concepts/memory-vs-rag
paragraphs.zh: 你的应用 / AI 工具 ↓ Supermemory │ ├── 记忆引擎 提取事实、跟踪更新、解决矛盾、自动遗忘过期信息 ├── 用户画像 由引擎构建的静态事实 + 动态上下文，始终保持最新 ├── 混合搜索 一次查询中同时进行 RAG + 记忆检索 ├── 连接器 从 Google Drive、Gmail、Notion、GitHub 等实时同步 └── 文件处理 PDF、图片、视频、代码 → 可搜索的分块 记忆不等于 RAG。 RAG 检索的是文档分块 —— 无状态，所有人得到相同的结果。 记忆则随时间提取并跟踪关于用户的事实。 它能理解「我刚搬到旧金山」会取代「我住在纽约」。Supermemory 默认同时运行两者，因此每次查询你都能同时获得知识库检索和个性化上下文。 在此处阅读更多相关内容 - https://supermemory.ai/docs/concepts/memory-vs-rag

sents.en: Your app / AI tool ↓ Supermemory │ ├── Memory Engine Extracts facts, tracks updates, resolves contradictions, │ auto-forgets expired info ├── User Profiles Static facts + dynamic context built from engine, always fresh ├── Hybrid Search RAG + Memory in one query ├── Connectors Real-time sync from Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, GitHub... └── File Processing PDFs, images, videos, code → searchable chunks Memory is not RAG.
sents.zh: 你的应用 / AI 工具 ↓ Supermemory │ ├── 记忆引擎 提取事实、跟踪更新、解决矛盾、自动遗忘过期信息 ├── 用户画像 由引擎构建的静态事实 + 动态上下文，始终保持最新 ├── 混合搜索 一次查询中同时进行 RAG + 记忆检索 ├── 连接器 从 Google Drive、Gmail、Notion、GitHub 等实时同步 └── 文件处理 PDF、图片、视频、代码 → 可搜索的分块 记忆不等于 RAG。

sents.en: RAG retrieves document chunks — stateless, same results for everyone.
sents.zh: RAG 检索的是文档分块 —— 无状态，所有人得到相同的结果。

sents.en: Memory extracts and tracks facts about users over time.
sents.zh: 记忆则随时间提取并跟踪关于用户的事实。

sents.en: It understands that "I just moved to SF" supersedes "I live in NYC." Supermemory runs both together by default, so you get knowledge base retrieval and personalized context in every query.
sents.zh: 它能理解「我刚搬到旧金山」会取代「我住在纽约」。Supermemory 默认同时运行两者，因此每次查询你都能同时获得知识库检索和个性化上下文。

sents.en: Read more about this here - https://supermemory.ai/docs/concepts/memory-vs-rag
sents.zh: 在此处阅读更多相关内容 - https://supermemory.ai/docs/concepts/memory-vs-rag

paragraphs.en: Automatic forgetting. Supermemory knows when memories become irrelevant. Temporary facts ("I have an exam tomorrow") expire after the date passes. Contradictions are resolved automatically. Noise never becomes permanent memory.
paragraphs.zh: 自动遗忘。 Supermemory 知道记忆何时变得不再相关。 临时事实（“我明天有一场考试”）会在日期过后自动失效。 矛盾会被自动解决。 噪声永远不会成为永久记忆。

sents.en: Automatic forgetting.
